findings.status: open — for the remediation wave (minor, does not gate a clean round)
findings.problem: The title renders the shared English demonstrative 'that' as उस while its paired body renders the same 'that' as इस, so the two stacked lines of one empty-state panel disagree about the search they both point at.
evidence: hi title 'उस खोज से कोई एजेंट मेल नहीं खाता।' vs hi body 'किसी एजेंट का नाम या विवरण इससे मेल नहीं खाता।' — the en sources are 'No agents match that search.' and 'No agent's name or description carries that.', both using 'that' for the same referent.

Both render stacked in one empty-state block with the query still mounted in the field: src/renderer/src/features/agent-hub/agent-hub-page.tsx:1458 (title

) immediately above :1483 (body

), inside the same hasFilters branch.

Every shipped hi sibling of this sentence uses the proximate for a query still visible: ui.hub.skills.search_empty 'इस खोज से कोई कौशल मेल नहीं खाता।', ui.providers.provider_grid.no_providers_match_this_search 'इस खोज से कोई प्रोवाइडर मेल नहीं खाता।', ui.chat.thread_search.empty 'इस खोज से कोई संदेश नहीं मिला।', ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.search_empty 'आपकी खोज से कोई एजेंट मेल नहीं खाता'.
findings.fix: Use one demonstrative across the pair. The proximate matches the mounted field and all four siblings: title 'इस खोज से कोई एजेंट मेल नहीं खाता।'. If the distant reading is intended instead, the body's 'इससे' becomes 'उससे' — either way, not one of each.
findings.impact: Wording coherence only. Meaning survives either reading, so there is no correctness, accessibility or shipping risk; it can ship as-is or ride the next remediation commit.

per_key.note: en 'The agent list could not be loaded.' -> 'एजेंट सूची लोड नहीं हो सकी।' Six words, one sentence, ends in danda as the caller's three-sentence join requires, and names no remedy of its own. 'एजेंट सूची' is the namespace's shipped compound (ui.hub.pages.signed_out.body 'एजेंट सूची पढ़ने के लिए'); the feminine head सूची governs 'हो सकी' and the construction matches the shipped load-failure pattern 'टीमें लोड नहीं हो सकीं' (ui.hub.teams.org.load_headline).

en 'That organization needs an active Team plan' -> 'उस संगठन के लिए सक्रिय Team प्लान ज़रूरी है'. Byte-identical to the shipped ui.hub.teams.org.plan_headline, which carries the same en string — exactly the pages/teams parallel its context note asks for. No trailing punctuation, as en has none, and it keeps the deliberate non-'hub could not be loaded' opening. 'Team प्लान' verbatim.

en 'You do not have access to that organization' -> 'आपके पास उस संगठन तक पहुँच नहीं है'. Byte-identical to the shipped teams sibling; 'उस संगठन' agrees with org.that_organization, which the context note requires; no trailing punctuation.

en two sentences, all three clauses present and in order. Clause-for-clause parallel to the shipped teams.org.plan_body. 'Radient कंसोल' and 'Team प्लान' verbatim with a single space; 'चालू कर सकता है' is the sibling's own activation verb; 'उसके एजेंट' agrees with masculine plural एजेंट and 'सूचीबद्ध होंगे' matches the teams sibling's 'सूचीबद्ध होंगी'. 'इसे' takes Team प्लान from the previous sentence.

en two sentences -> 'आप {org} के सदस्य नहीं हैं, इसलिए उसके एजेंट यहाँ सूचीबद्ध नहीं हैं। कोई मालिक आपको फिर से आमंत्रित कर सकता है।' Same frame word for word as the shipped teams sibling; the second sentence is the same remedy (an owner can invite again) and invents no control, as its context note forbids.

en 'that organization' -> 'उस संगठन'. Identical to the shipped teams sibling and to pages' own scope.org_unnamed family. A bare noun phrase, correct in the slots that consume it: 'उस संगठन का कोई मालिक' and 'आप उस संगठन के सदस्य नहीं हैं'. Lower-case and fragment-like, as the context asks (Devanagari has no case).

en 'This organization has no shared agents yet.' -> 'इस संगठन के साथ अभी कोई एजेंट साझा नहीं किया गया है।' '… के साथ साझा' is this namespace's settled idiom for sharing into/with an org (ui.hub.pages.orgs_below_version 'संगठन के साथ एजेंट साझा करने के लिए', ui.hub.taxonomy.origin.named '{name} के साथ साझा'), so the new heading follows the locale rather than diverging. Natural negative with 'कोई एजेंट … नहीं किया गया'; trailing danda matches en; 12 words against en's 8 stays inside the spread of the four sibling headings.

en 'Agents published into {org} appear here for its members.' -> '{org} में प्रकाशित एजेंट यहाँ उसके सदस्यों को दिखते हैं।' Names the audience (उसके सदस्यों को) as the context note requires and pointedly avoids the public hub's 'आपका पहला', which would invite a publication this surface cannot make. 'में प्रकाशित' follows en 'published into'; structure mirrors ui.hub.teams.org.empty. दिखते agrees with masculine plural एजेंट, as elsewhere in the namespace.

en 'No agents in {category}.' -> '{category} में कोई एजेंट नहीं।' {category} fronted before में and left undeclined in the direct case, which is what its context note demands ('insert it whole, do not decline or re-case it'); the trailing danda matches en. The interpolated labels are themselves translated in hi (ui.hub.taxonomy.category.*: शोध, लेखांकन, स्वास्थ्य सेवा), so this renders as clean Hindi with no mixed-script residue.

en two sentences -> 'इस श्रेणी में अभी कुछ नहीं है। पूरा हब देखने के लिए फ़िल्टर हटाएँ।' Second sentence is the imperative its context asks for and names the delivered control; 'फ़िल्टर' is the same noun as clear.filter, which the context makes a requirement. 'श्रेणी' is the settled hi category term.

en 'No agents match that search.' -> 'उस खोज से कोई एजेंट मेल नहीं खाता।' The frame and the idiom 'मेल नहीं खाता' are exactly the shipped ones — ui.agents.navigation.sidebar.search_empty is this same sentence with a different demonstrative slot — but the demonstrative itself is the divergence recorded as H-P1: उस here against this pair's own इस and every shipped sibling's proximate.

en 'No agent's name or description carries that. Clear it to see the whole hub.' -> 'किसी एजेंट का नाम या विवरण इससे मेल नहीं खाता। पूरा हब देखने के लिए खोज हटाएँ।' Names what the search covered (नाम या विवरण), uses the same noun as clear.search ('खोज हटाएँ'), and does not borrow the category miss's phrasing. Its 'इससे' is the other half of H-P1 — H-P1 is filed against the title because the title is the edit site I recommend, not because the body is correct in isolation.
en 'The hub is empty.' -> 'हब खाली है।' Exact, three words, and short enough to keep the shared four-way heading slot from reflowing — the concern its context note raises.

en two sentences: nobody has published yet, and the reader's own could be the first. Both present; the invitation is 'आपका पहला हो सकता है।' with masculine पहला agreeing with एजेंट, and it is correctly reserved for the public scope.

en 'Clear filter' -> 'फ़िल्टर हटाएँ'. 'हटाएँ' is the polite imperative the style guide lists by name; two words like en, no punctuation, and the same noun as empty.category.body, which the context makes a requirement. The panel holds it without wrapping.
en 'Clear search' -> 'खोज हटाएँ'. Two words like en; same noun as empty.search.body; same imperative as its sibling button, so the two pair as one voice.

verified: completeness: 17 new keys present (16 ui.hub.pages + 1 ui.hub.teams); no value equals its key id; en and hi key sets equal at this head (pages 59/59, teams 50/50)

placeholders: parity with en proven per key — {org} in org.plan_body, org.no_access_body, empty.org.body; {category} in empty.category.title; the other 13 keys are placeholder-free. Positions are grammatical: {org} as possessor ('{org} का कोई मालिक'), as postpositional object ('आप {org} के सदस्य नहीं हैं') and as locative ('{org} में प्रकाशित'); {category} fronted before में and left undeclined, as its en context requires. No placeholder renamed, dropped, doubled or moved into an ungrammatical slot.
CLDR plurals: NO key in this delta carries a plural or a select — reported explicitly as the brief requires. The namespace's existing {count, plural, one/other} forms are untouched.

text hygiene: no manual bidi or zero-width controls (no U+200B/200C/200D/2060/FEFF, none of U+202A–202E or U+2066–2069) in any of the 17 values; all values NFC; no leading, trailing or double spaces; no space before punctuation — the style guide's 'do not insert ZWJ/ZWNJ where the orthography does not require them' holds.

punctuation parity: every en sentence-final '.' maps to danda ।; the headline, label and fragment keys (plan_headline, no_access_headline, that_organization, clear.filter, clear.search, unnamed_team) stay unpunctuated exactly like their en source; no ASCII '.' and no '…' residue.
nukta: फ़िल्टर, ज़रूरी carry nukta, as the style guide requires ('it is part of the spelling, not decoration'). No value is missing a nukta its shipped sibling has.

Devanagari spelling: all 17 values checked character by character — no malformed matra or conjunct; सूचीबद्ध, आमंत्रित, प्रकाशित, विवरण, श्रेणी, पहुँच, होंगे, हटाएँ, दिखते, सकी/सकीं are all standard spellings, and हटाएँ is the very imperative the style guide lists ('सहेजें', 'फिर से शुरू करें', 'हटाएँ', 'रद्द करें').

register: आप throughout, polite imperative only (हटाएँ, कोशिश-करें class), no तुम/तू, no 'कृपया', no '!', no padding honorifics. The तत्सम/तद्भव balance matches the shipped hi ui.hub voice exactly: तत्सम nouns where the namespace already settled them (संगठन, सदस्य, सूचीबद्ध, आमंत्रित, प्रकाशित, श्रेणी, विवरण) on an everyday तद्भव frame (अभी, कुछ, पहला, मेल खाना, खाली, हटाएँ, ज़रूरी, दिखते). No key drifts into heavy Sanskritisation or into colloquialism.

product names kept verbatim exactly as the brief requires: 'Team प्लान' in org.plan_headline and org.plan_body, 'Radient कंसोल' in org.plan_body — both half-width Latin, single-spaced, never transliterated. These plus the {org}/{category} slots are the only Latin in the delta; no other English residue.

terminology consistency: 'श्रेणी' is the settled category term (ui.common.forms.categories_input_chips.remove_category, ui.agents.settings.general.add_category, ui.onboarding.tour.agent_hub_view); 'खोज' is the settled search noun (ui.hub.skills.search_empty, ui.providers.provider_grid.clear_search, ui.chat.thread_search.*); 'हटाएँ' is the settled clear verb (ui.providers.provider_grid.clear_search, ui.chat.sidebar.search.clear says साफ़ करें — an existing split, not introduced here); 'टीम' is the glossary's settled rendering for team.

pages/teams one voice: every pages key that has a teams sibling is clause-for-clause parallel to it and reuses its frame — plan_headline and no_access_headline are byte-identical to the shipped teams values for byte-identical en, plan_body mirrors teams.org.plan_body ('…का हिस्सा है। {org} का कोई मालिक इसे Radient कंसोल में चालू कर सकता है, और फिर … यहाँ सूचीबद्ध होंगे/होंगी।'), no_access_body mirrors teams.org.no_access_body, and empty.org.body mirrors teams.org.empty ('यहाँ उसके सदस्यों को दिखते/दिखती हैं').

render-site safety: the org fallback substituted for {org} is a noun phrase in every site, so उस संगठन and इस संगठन both take का/के/में correctly (agent-hub-page.tsx:1355-1362 for the refusal bodies, :1475-1479 for empty.org.body, :1453-1455 for {category}); list_unreadable really is joined with the shared diagnosis and remedy by backendLoadErrorMessage (agent-hub-page.tsx:1284-1288), which is why its trailing danda matters and is present; the category and search empty headings render only when their own filter is live (hasFilters = selectedCategory !== null || debouncedSearch !== '', agent-hub-page.tsx:361), so neither premise is wrong.

glossary and style guide were read as the authority for these calls (glossary §1 product names, §2 team→टीम / agent→एजेंट; style-guide 'Formality & tone', 'Product-name policy', 'Punctuation & typography').
out_of_scope_pre_existing: ui.hub.pages.browse_aria renders 'browse the hub by type' as 'प्रकार के अनुसार हब देखें' while the category term everywhere else in hi is श्रेणी — pre-existing, not touched by this delta, does not gate.

ui.hub.teams.org.empty renders en 'Teams shared into {org}' as '{org} के साथ साझा की गई टीमें' — pre-existing; the new pages empty.org.title follows the same settled '… के साथ साझा' idiom rather than diverging from it.

ui.hub.teams.org.plan_headline points with उस while its body's {org} fallback ui.hub.pages.scope.org_unnamed is 'इस संगठन' — pre-existing and inherited from en, which itself mixes 'That organization' with 'this organization'; the new pages pair reproduces it exactly and is not a translation defect.
ship: yes — no BLOCKER and no MAJOR; H-P1 is wording coherence and does not gate.
